examples.en: Many parents enroll their kids in hobby classes to help them discover new interests.
examples.zh: 许多家长给孩子报兴趣班，帮他们发现新的兴趣。

entries.shortAnswer: hobby classes 的中文意思是兴趣班，指孩子课外以培养兴趣和特长为主的课程。
entries.definition: 复数名词，指儿童或成人参加的课外兴趣课程，如绘画、舞蹈等。搭配 take hobby classes、sign up for hobby classes。不是补习班。

examples.en: My daughter takes hobby classes on weekends, including painting and ballet.
examples.zh: 我女儿周末上兴趣班，包括绘画和芭蕾。

examples.en: Many parents enroll their kids in hobby classes to help them discover new interests.
examples.zh: 许多家长给孩子报兴趣班，帮他们发现新的兴趣。

entries.shortAnswer: 学区房指为按片入学而买的住房，英文常说 school district housing。
entries.definition: school district housing 指为获得优质公立学校入学资格而购置的房产。它不是普通「学区内的房子」，而是带入学溢价的投资品。

examples.en: Many parents in big cities are willing to pay a huge premium for school district housing to get their child into a top primary school.
examples.zh: 大城市里许多家长为了让孩子进入顶尖小学，愿意为学区房支付高昂溢价。

examples.en: The couple sold their spacious apartment and bought a tiny school district housing unit just for the enrollment slot.
examples.zh: 那对夫妇卖掉了宽敞的公寓，只为获得入学名额而买了一套狭小的学区房。

entries.shortAnswer: School district housing means 学区房: a home bought for its school admission rights.
entries.definition: School district housing is property bought to secure a place at a top public school, often at a steep premium.

examples.en: Many parents in big cities are willing to pay a huge premium for school district housing to get their child into a top primary school.
examples.zh: 大城市里许多家长为了让孩子进入顶尖小学，愿意为学区房支付高昂溢价。

examples.en: The couple sold their spacious apartment and bought a tiny school district housing unit just for the enrollment slot.
examples.zh: 那对夫妇卖掉了宽敞的公寓，只为获得入学名额而买了一套狭小的学区房。

entries.shortAnswer: 幼儿园的英文是 kindergarten，指3-6岁儿童接受学前教育的机构，注意与 nursery 托儿所区分。
entries.definition: Kindergarten 源于德语，指儿童通过游戏和活动学习社交与基础技能的场所，常见搭配有 go to kindergarten。

examples.en: My daughter started kindergarten this year and loves her teacher.
examples.zh: 我女儿今年上幼儿园了，她很喜欢她的老师。

examples.en: In the US, children usually attend kindergarten at age five before first grade.
examples.zh: 在美国，孩子们通常在五岁时上幼儿园，然后才上一年级。

entries.shortAnswer: Kindergarten 的中文意思是幼儿园，通常指3-6岁儿童接受学前教育的机构，与 nursery 不同。
entries.definition: Kindergarten 指儿童在进入小学前接受教育的场所或阶段，常见搭配有 attend kindergarten。

examples.en: My daughter started kindergarten this year and loves her teacher.
examples.zh: 我女儿今年上幼儿园了，她很喜欢她的老师。

examples.en: In the US, children usually attend kindergarten at age five before first grade.
examples.zh: 在美国，孩子们通常在五岁时上幼儿园，然后才上一年级。

entries.shortAnswer: 家长群的英文是 parents chat group，指老师和家长在微信上的家校沟通群，类似英文里的 parents' WhatsApp group，别直译成 parents group。
entries.definition: 家长群常指老师与家长在微信上建的班级群，用于通知作业、接龙回复和活动报名，最典型的是满屏「收到」。英国多用 WhatsApp 家长群。

examples.en: Every evening, the parents chat group floods with "received" messages after the teacher posts homework.
examples.zh: 每天晚上老师一发作业，家长群里就刷屏式地回复「收到」。

examples.en: I muted the parents chat group because it kept buzzing during meetings.
examples.zh: 我把家长群设成免打扰了，因为开会时它一直响。

entries.shortAnswer: Parents chat group 的中文意思是家长群，指中国老师和家长在微信上建的家校沟通群，功能类似 parents' WhatsApp group，但平台不同。
entries.definition: parents chat group 指家长与老师组成的线上群聊，常见搭配有 set up a parents chat group、be in the parents chat group，正式语境可用 parent-teacher communication channel。

examples.en: Every evening, the parents chat group floods with "received" messages after the teacher posts homework.
examples.zh: 每天晚上老师一发作业，家长群里就刷屏式地回复「收到」。

examples.en: I muted the parents chat group because it kept buzzing during meetings.
examples.zh: 我把家长群设成免打扰了，因为开会时它一直响。

entries.shortAnswer: 「陪写作业」英文说 supervising homework，指家长在孩子做功课时在旁督促辅导。
entries.definition: supervising homework 指家长在孩子做功课时从旁督促检查并辅导，强调监督陪伴，不是代写。

examples.en: Every evening she spends an hour supervising homework at the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 每天晚饭后，她都会在餐桌旁花一个小时陪写作业。

examples.en: Many working parents find supervising homework more tiring than their own jobs.
examples.zh: 许多在职父母觉得陪写作业比上班还累。

entries.shortAnswer: Supervising homework means 陪写作业: a parent watches and helps a child do schoolwork.
entries.definition: Supervising homework means a parent stays with a child during homework, checking and helping, not doing it.

examples.en: Every evening she spends an hour supervising homework at the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 每天晚饭后，她都会在餐桌旁花一个小时陪写作业。

examples.en: Many working parents find supervising homework more tiring than their own jobs.
examples.zh: 许多在职父母觉得陪写作业比上班还累。

entries.shortAnswer: 「小升初」英文常说 primary to middle school，指小学升初中的过渡阶段。
entries.definition: primary to middle school 是描述性短语，非官方考试名称，强调从小学到初中的升学阶段。常见搭配：the primary to middle school transition。

examples.en: Many parents start preparing their children for the primary to middle school transition a year in advance.
examples.zh: 许多家长提前一年就开始为孩子的小升初过渡做准备。

examples.en: The primary to middle school years can be stressful for both children and their families.
examples.zh: 小升初阶段对孩子和家庭来说都可能压力很大。

entries.shortAnswer: Primary to middle school 的中文意思是「小升初」，指孩子从小学升入初中的阶段。
entries.definition: 该短语多用于教育、育儿语境，指小学到初中的过渡期，可搭配 transition、admission、preparation 等词使用。

examples.en: Many parents start preparing their children for the primary to middle school transition a year in advance.
examples.zh: 许多家长提前一年就开始为孩子的小升初过渡做准备。

examples.en: The primary to middle school years can be stressful for both children and their families.
examples.zh: 小升初阶段对孩子和家庭来说都可能压力很大。

entries.shortAnswer: 「虎妈」的英文是 tiger mom，指用严格高压方式督促孩子学业与才艺的母亲。
entries.definition: tiger mom 源自蔡美儿《虎妈战歌》，指严格高压的育儿方式，常与 strict、demanding 搭配。

examples.en: Amy Chua made the term "tiger mom" famous around the world.
examples.zh: 蔡美儿让「虎妈」一词闻名世界。

examples.en: Some parents admire the tiger mom's discipline, but others say it pressures kids too much.
examples.zh: 有些家长欣赏虎妈式的严格，另一些人则认为这给孩子压力太大。

entries.shortAnswer: Tiger mom is the English term for 「虎妈」, a mother who pushes her kids hard to excel.
entries.definition: A tiger mom is a strict, demanding mother who pushes her children hard in school and music, a term from Amy Chua.

examples.en: Amy Chua made the term "tiger mom" famous around the world.
examples.zh: 蔡美儿让「虎妈」一词闻名世界。

examples.en: Some parents admire the tiger mom's discipline, but others say it pressures kids too much.
examples.zh: 有些家长欣赏虎妈式的严格，另一些人则认为这给孩子压力太大。

entries.shortAnswer: 「隔代养育」的英文是 grandparent childcare，指祖辈分担日常带娃。
entries.definition: grandparent childcare 是中性偏正式说法，常搭 rely on、provide。注意：它不等于祖辈完全取代父母抚养。

examples.en: In many Chinese dual-income families, grandparent childcare is the default arrangement rather than a backup plan.
examples.zh: 在中国许多双职工家庭里，隔代养育是默认安排，而不是备用方案。

examples.en: Western families also use grandparent childcare, but usually for shorter hours and with fewer daily caregiving expectations.
examples.zh: 西方家庭也会让祖辈帮忙带娃，但通常时间更短，日常照料的期待也更少。

entries.shortAnswer: Grandparent childcare 的中文是「隔代养育」，指祖父母日常帮忙照看孙辈。
entries.definition: grandparent childcare 多用于社会学与育儿政策语境，指祖辈作为托育资源，常与 rely on 连用。

examples.en: In many Chinese dual-income families, grandparent childcare is the default arrangement rather than a backup plan.
examples.zh: 在中国许多双职工家庭里，隔代养育是默认安排，而不是备用方案。

examples.en: Western families also use grandparent childcare, but usually for shorter hours and with fewer daily caregiving expectations.
examples.zh: 西方家庭也会让祖辈帮忙带娃，但通常时间更短，日常照料的期待也更少。

entries.shortAnswer: 「胎教」英文是 prenatal education，指孕期通过音乐、语言等刺激促进胎儿发育。
entries.definition: prenatal education 指胎教，即孕期给胎儿提供文化、音乐等良性刺激，区别于产检 prenatal care。

examples.en: Many parents believe prenatal education helps a baby's brain develop.
examples.zh: 许多父母认为胎教有助于宝宝大脑发育。

examples.en: She played classical music daily as part of her prenatal education.
examples.zh: 她每天播放古典音乐，作为胎教的一部分。

entries.shortAnswer: Prenatal education is 胎教 in Chinese: stimulating a fetus with music, talk, and touch before birth.
entries.definition: Prenatal education means 胎教: enriching a fetus with music, speech, and touch, not medical prenatal care.

examples.en: Many parents believe prenatal education helps a baby's brain develop.
examples.zh: 许多父母认为胎教有助于宝宝大脑发育。

examples.en: She played classical music daily as part of her prenatal education.
examples.zh: 她每天播放古典音乐，作为胎教的一部分。

entries.shortAnswer: 「鸡娃」常译 intensive parenting，指父母高强度投入资源推孩子抢跑竞争。
entries.definition: 鸡娃是网络热词，指给孩子打鸡血式教育，英文常译 intensive parenting，媒体也用 jiwa。

examples.en: Many Chinese families practice intensive parenting, enrolling kids in math, English and piano before primary school.
examples.zh: 许多中国家庭践行鸡娃式教育，孩子还没上小学就报了数学、英语和钢琴班。

examples.en: Intensive parenting captures the anxiety of parents competing to give their children an edge.
examples.zh: 鸡娃式教育捕捉了父母争相让孩子抢跑的那种焦虑。

entries.shortAnswer: Intensive parenting is the English term for 「鸡娃」, a high-pressure, resource-heavy style.
entries.definition: Intensive parenting means investing heavily in a child's education and activities, often competitive. In Chinese it is 「鸡娃」.

examples.en: Many Chinese families practice intensive parenting, enrolling kids in math, English and piano before primary school.
examples.zh: 许多中国家庭践行鸡娃式教育，孩子还没上小学就报了数学、英语和钢琴班。

examples.en: Intensive parenting captures the anxiety of parents competing to give their children an edge.
examples.zh: 鸡娃式教育捕捉了父母争相让孩子抢跑的那种焦虑。

entries.shortAnswer: 「生育津贴」英文是 maternity allowance，产假期间发放的现金补助。
entries.definition: maternity allowance 指产假期间由政府或雇主发放的现金补助，常与 claim、receive 等词搭配。

examples.en: She applied for a maternity allowance after her employer approved her maternity leave.
examples.zh: 在雇主批准她的产假后，她申请了生育津贴。

examples.en: Maternity allowance is paid by the maternity insurance fund based on average salary.
examples.zh: 生育津贴由生育保险基金根据平均工资发放。

entries.shortAnswer: maternity allowance 中文是「生育津贴」，即产假期间的现金补助。
entries.definition: maternity allowance 指产假期间发放的定期现金补贴，常见搭配 claim、receive、be eligible for。

examples.en: She applied for a maternity allowance after her employer approved her maternity leave.
examples.zh: 在雇主批准她的产假后，她申请了生育津贴。

examples.en: Maternity allowance is paid by the maternity insurance fund based on average salary.
examples.zh: 生育津贴由生育保险基金根据平均工资发放。

entries.shortAnswer: 「丰巢」的英文是 Hive Box locker，指小区和写字楼里的智能快递柜，常用于无接触取件。
entries.definition: Hive Box locker 指丰巢智能快递柜，用于暂存和自助取件，常见搭配有 drop off a parcel、collect a parcel。

examples.en: The courier left my package in a Hive Box locker because I wasn't home to receive it.
examples.zh: 快递员把包裹放进了丰巢，因为我不在家收件。

examples.en: You can collect a parcel from the Hive Box locker by scanning the pickup code on your phone.
examples.zh: 你可以用手机扫描取件码，从丰巢里取走包裹。

entries.shortAnswer: Hive Box locker means 丰巢, a smart parcel locker brand in China, used for contactless parcel pickup.
entries.definition: Hive Box locker 即丰巢智能快递柜，常见于小区和写字楼，用于暂存包裹和自助取件，搭配 collect a parcel。

examples.en: The courier left my package in a Hive Box locker because I wasn't home to receive it.
examples.zh: 快递员把包裹放进了丰巢，因为我不在家收件。

examples.en: You can collect a parcel from the Hive Box locker by scanning the pickup code on your phone.
examples.zh: 你可以用手机扫描取件码，从丰巢里取走包裹。

entries.shortAnswer: 「产假」的英文是 maternity leave，指职业女性因生育和产后恢复享有的法定休假，父亲对应的是 paternity leave。
entries.definition: maternity leave 指女性产前产后依法享有的带薪或不带薪休假，中国基础产假 98 天，各地多有奖励假。常见搭配：on maternity leave、take maternity leave。

examples.en: She is on maternity leave until the end of October and will be back at work in November.
examples.zh: 她正在休产假，一直到十月底，十一月就会回来上班。

examples.en: Under Chinese law, new mothers are entitled to at least 98 days of maternity leave, plus extra days in many provinces.
examples.zh: 根据中国法律，新手妈妈至少享有 98 天产假，许多省份还会额外延长。

entries.shortAnswer: maternity leave 的中文意思是「产假」，即职业女性因生育和产后休养获得的法定休假，与父亲的陪产假 paternity leave 相对。
entries.definition: maternity leave 指女性员工生育前后依法享有的休假，通常带薪或部分带薪。常见搭配：be on maternity leave、go on maternity leave、maternity leave pay。

examples.en: She is on maternity leave until the end of October and will be back at work in November.
examples.zh: 她正在休产假，一直到十月底，十一月就会回来上班。

examples.en: Under Chinese law, new mothers are entitled to at least 98 days of maternity leave, plus extra days in many provinces.
examples.zh: 根据中国法律，新手妈妈至少享有 98 天产假，许多省份还会额外延长。

entries.shortAnswer: 「户口」的英文是 household registration，指中国按家庭登记人口、绑定福利与入学资格的户籍制度。注意别直译成 account 或 hukou 当普通名词用。
entries.definition: 常用搭配：household registration system（户籍制度）、have/obtain local household registration。口语里也直接音译作 hukou，但正式英文写作仍推荐 household registration。

examples.en: Without local household registration, their child may not be able to attend the nearby public school.
examples.zh: 没有本地户口，他们的孩子可能上不了附近的公立学校。

examples.en: The couple decided to move back to their hometown so the baby could get household registration there.
examples.zh: 这对夫妻决定搬回老家，好让宝宝在那里办户口。

entries.shortAnswer: Household registration 的中文意思是「户口」，指中国按家庭登记人口、并据此分配教育医疗等权益的户籍制度。它与 census（人口普查）不同，是长期身份登记而非统计。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：household registration system、apply for household registration。正式场合多用全称，口语和媒体报道中常直接写作 hukou，两者指向同一制度，不可与 residence permit 混用。

examples.en: Without local household registration, their child may not be able to attend the nearby public school.
examples.zh: 没有本地户口，他们的孩子可能上不了附近的公立学校。

examples.en: The couple decided to move back to their hometown so the baby could get household registration there.
examples.zh: 这对夫妻决定搬回老家，好让宝宝在那里办户口。

entries.shortAnswer: 「菜鸟驿站」的英文是 parcel pickup station，指社区包裹代收点，供收件人自提。
entries.definition: parcel pickup station 是「菜鸟驿站」的标准英译，指有人工值守的社区包裹代收点，收件人凭取件码自提。

examples.en: The courier left my package at the parcel pickup station, so I need to collect it after work.
examples.zh: 快递员把我的包裹放在了菜鸟驿站，所以我下班后要去取。

examples.en: If you are not home, you can redirect the delivery to a nearby parcel pickup station for pickup.
examples.zh: 如果你不在家，可以把派送改到附近的菜鸟驿站进行取件。

entries.shortAnswer: A parcel pickup station is a「菜鸟驿站」, a staffed community counter for parcel self-pickup.
entries.definition: parcel pickup station means「菜鸟驿站」: a staffed community counter where couriers leave parcels for self-pickup, not a locker.

examples.en: The courier left my package at the parcel pickup station, so I need to collect it after work.
examples.zh: 快递员把我的包裹放在了菜鸟驿站，所以我下班后要去取。

examples.en: If you are not home, you can redirect the delivery to a nearby parcel pickup station for pickup.
examples.zh: 如果你不在家，可以把派送改到附近的菜鸟驿站进行取件。

entries.shortAnswer: 「顺丰」的英文是 SF Express。品牌名 SF 保留不译，注意它指顺丰速运这家高端快递公司，不要写成 Shunfeng。
entries.definition: SF Express 专指顺丰速运，主打航空件与半日达。常见搭配：ship via SF Express（用顺丰寄）、SF Express collect（顺丰揽收）、SF Express delivers（顺丰派件）。与四通一达的电商件分层，顺丰=贵但快。

examples.en: I need to ship this document to Beijing before noon, so I'll use SF Express for half-day delivery.
examples.zh: 我需要中午前把这份文件寄到北京，所以我会用顺丰寄，走半日达。

examples.en: The seller sent the package via SF Express collect, and it arrived the next day.
examples.zh: 卖家通过顺丰揽收寄出了包裹，第二天就到了。

entries.shortAnswer: SF Express 的中文意思是「顺丰」。它特指顺丰速运这家中国高端快递公司，不是普通快递的通称。
entries.definition: SF Express 是顺丰速运的英文品牌名，SF 保留不译。常见搭配：send by SF Express、SF Express tracking number。多用于正式或指定快递的场合；易错点：它不等于 generic courier，不要泛指所有快递。

examples.en: I need to ship this document to Beijing before noon, so I'll use SF Express for half-day delivery.
examples.zh: 我需要中午前把这份文件寄到北京，所以我会用顺丰寄，走半日达。

examples.en: The seller sent the package via SF Express collect, and it arrived the next day.
examples.zh: 卖家通过顺丰揽收寄出了包裹，第二天就到了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「平邮」的英文是 surface mail，走海运或陆运的普通慢速邮件，比 airmail 便宜但慢。
entries.definition: surface mail 指走海运或陆路的普通邮件，邮费低、时效慢，通常无追踪，急件应选航空或快递。

examples.en: If you want to save money, you can send the books by surface mail; they will take about six weeks to arrive.
examples.zh: 如果想省钱，你可以用平邮寄这些书，大约六周才能到。

examples.en: The parcel was shipped by surface mail, so it has no tracking number and cannot be delivered any faster.
examples.zh: 这个包裹走的是平邮，所以没有追踪单号，也没法更快派送。

entries.shortAnswer: surface mail 的中文意思是「平邮」，即走海运或陆运的慢速邮件，比 airmail 便宜。
entries.definition: surface mail 是不可数名词，常见搭配有 by surface mail、surface mail rate，时效按周计，多用于不急的国际包裹。

examples.en: If you want to save money, you can send the books by surface mail; they will take about six weeks to arrive.
examples.zh: 如果想省钱，你可以用平邮寄这些书，大约六周才能到。

examples.en: The parcel was shipped by surface mail, so it has no tracking number and cannot be delivered any faster.
examples.zh: 这个包裹走的是平邮，所以没有追踪单号，也没法更快派送。

entries.shortAnswer: 「派件」的英文是 deliver a parcel，指快递员把包裹送到收件人手中，注意区分揽收和派件。
entries.definition: 派件指快递末端配送，常见搭配：deliver a parcel to sb（把包裹派送给某人）、out for delivery（派件中），与揽收相对。

examples.en: The courier will deliver a parcel to your doorstep this afternoon.
examples.zh: 快递员今天下午会把包裹派送到你家门口。

examples.en: If you miss the delivery, you can reschedule to have them deliver a parcel another day.
examples.zh: 如果你错过了派件，可以改约让他们另一天再派送包裹。

entries.shortAnswer: Deliver a parcel means 派件 in Chinese, referring to a courier taking a package to the recipient.
entries.definition: Deliver a parcel is used when a courier brings a package to the recipient's address, the final leg of shipping.

examples.en: The courier will deliver a parcel to your doorstep this afternoon.
examples.zh: 快递员今天下午会把包裹派送到你家门口。

examples.en: If you miss the delivery, you can reschedule to have them deliver a parcel another day.
examples.zh: 如果你错过了派件，可以改约让他们另一天再派送包裹。

entries.shortAnswer: 菜鸟裹裹英文说 parcel tracking app，指菜鸟网络的快递查询与代收应用。
entries.definition: 菜鸟裹裹是菜鸟网络旗下快递查询与代收平台，英文常说 Cai Niao Guo Guo, a parcel tracking app。查快递、取件码、驿站是常见搭配。

examples.en: I use a parcel tracking app to check where my package is, and it even sends a pickup code for the local station.
examples.zh: 我用菜鸟裹裹查包裹到哪了，它还会发驿站的取件码。

examples.en: If you ship items to China often, install a parcel tracking app so you can follow consolidated shipping and contactless delivery updates.
examples.zh: 如果你经常往中国寄东西，装个菜鸟裹裹就能跟进集运和无接触配送的更新。

entries.shortAnswer: parcel tracking app 对应中文菜鸟裹裹，指菜鸟网络推出的快递查询与代收应用。
entries.definition: parcel tracking app 指查询包裹物流轨迹的应用，常见搭配 track a parcel、pickup code、delivery notification，泛指时用 package tracking app。

examples.en: I use a parcel tracking app to check where my package is, and it even sends a pickup code for the local station.
examples.zh: 我用菜鸟裹裹查包裹到哪了，它还会发驿站的取件码。

examples.en: If you ship items to China often, install a parcel tracking app so you can follow consolidated shipping and contactless delivery updates.
examples.zh: 如果你经常往中国寄东西，装个菜鸟裹裹就能跟进集运和无接触配送的更新。

entries.shortAnswer: 「揽收」的英文是 collect a parcel，指快递员从寄件人处取件并录入系统，注意与派件方向相反。
entries.definition: 揽收是快递流程的起点，英文常用 collect a parcel 或 pick up a parcel；常见搭配：快递员揽收、上门揽收、已揽收。与派件（deliver a parcel）方向相反，写物流状态时不要混用。

examples.en: The courier will collect a parcel from your home tomorrow morning, so please have it packed and the shipping label printed.
examples.zh: 快递员明天上午会上门揽收，请提前打包好包裹并打印好面单。

examples.en: Your order has been collected by the courier and is now on the way to the sorting center; you can track it with the tracking number.
examples.zh: 您的订单已被快递员揽收，正在发往分拣中心，您可以用运单号追踪。

entries.shortAnswer: 「collect a parcel」的中文意思是「揽收」，即快递员从寄件人处取走包裹。
entries.definition: collect a parcel 指快递员上门从寄件人处取件并录入系统，常见于物流追踪状态。英式英语常用 collect，美式口语也说 pick up a parcel；注意它不等于 deliver a parcel（派件）。

examples.en: The courier will collect a parcel from your home tomorrow morning, so please have it packed and the shipping label printed.
examples.zh: 快递员明天上午会上门揽收，请提前打包好包裹并打印好面单。

examples.en: Your order has been collected by the courier and is now on the way to the sorting center; you can track it with the tracking number.
examples.zh: 您的订单已被快递员揽收，正在发往分拣中心，您可以用运单号追踪。

entries.shortAnswer: 「上门取件」的英文是 door pickup，指快递员上门揽收包裹，与 drop-off 相反。
entries.definition: door pickup 用于寄件场景，常搭配 schedule a door pickup（预约上门取件）、free door pickup。

examples.en: I scheduled a door pickup for my return package, so the courier will come to my apartment tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我预约了退货包裹的上门取件，所以快递员明天早上会来我公寓。

examples.en: Does this store offer free door pickup for heavy items? I don't want to carry them to the courier station.
examples.zh: 这家店对大件商品提供免费上门取件吗？我不想自己搬到快递驿站。

entries.shortAnswer: Door pickup means 上门取件, a courier collecting your parcel, the opposite of drop-off.
entries.definition: Door pickup is a logistics term for a courier coming to collect your parcel at home or office, common in returns.

examples.en: I scheduled a door pickup for my return package, so the courier will come to my apartment tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我预约了退货包裹的上门取件，所以快递员明天早上会来我公寓。

examples.en: Does this store offer free door pickup for heavy items? I don't want to carry them to the courier station.
examples.zh: 这家店对大件商品提供免费上门取件吗？我不想自己搬到快递驿站。

entries.shortAnswer: 「转运」的英文是 package forwarding，指把包裹转寄到别处，强调转寄而非合并。
entries.definition: package forwarding 指把包裹转寄到另一地址，常用于海外购物代收；若合并多包裹发货则说 consolidated shipping。

examples.en: I used a package forwarding service to send my online orders from the US to Shanghai.
examples.zh: 我用转运服务把网购的东西从美国寄到了上海。

examples.en: Before choosing a package forwarding company, check how they handle declared value and return shipping.
examples.zh: 选择转运公司之前，先了解他们如何处理保价和退货运费。

entries.shortAnswer: Package forwarding means 转运: reshipping a parcel to another address.
entries.definition: Package forwarding is reshipping a parcel to a different address, often abroad; it differs from consolidated shipping.

examples.en: I used a package forwarding service to send my online orders from the US to Shanghai.
examples.zh: 我用转运服务把网购的东西从美国寄到了上海。

examples.en: Before choosing a package forwarding company, check how they handle declared value and return shipping.
examples.zh: 选择转运公司之前，先了解他们如何处理保价和退货运费。

entries.shortAnswer: 「保价」的英文是 declared parcel value，即寄件时声明包裹价值并付保价费。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：declare a parcel value（为包裹保价）。注意与保险 insurance、报关申报价值区分。

examples.en: Please fill in the declared parcel value on the shipping label before handing the package to the courier.
examples.zh: 把包裹交给快递员之前，请在面单上填写保价金额。

examples.en: If you set a declared parcel value, the carrier will compensate you based on that amount when the parcel is lost or damaged.
examples.zh: 如果你做了保价，包裹丢失或损坏时，快递公司会按声明价值赔偿。

entries.shortAnswer: declared parcel value means 保价, the parcel value you declare for compensation.
entries.definition: The value a sender declares for a parcel, which couriers use to set 保价 fees and pay compensation.

examples.en: Please fill in the declared parcel value on the shipping label before handing the package to the courier.
examples.zh: 把包裹交给快递员之前，请在面单上填写保价金额。

examples.en: If you set a declared parcel value, the carrier will compensate you based on that amount when the parcel is lost or damaged.
examples.zh: 如果你做了保价，包裹丢失或损坏时，快递公司会按声明价值赔偿。

entries.shortAnswer: 「面单」英文是 shipping label，指贴在包裹上的运单标签，侧重物流运输单据。
entries.definition: 面单指快递包裹外贴的运单标签，含收发件人、条码和路由信息，英文常说 shipping label。搭配：打印面单、贴面单。

examples.en: Please print a shipping label and attach it to the parcel before dropping it off at the courier station.
examples.zh: 寄件前请打印面单并贴在包裹上，然后放到快递驿站。

examples.en: The seller provided a prepaid shipping label for the return, so I didn't pay for shipping.
examples.zh: 卖家提供了预付费退货运单（面单），所以我没有付退货运费。

entries.shortAnswer: shipping label 中文意思是「面单」，即贴在包裹上的运单标签，侧重实际标签。
entries.definition: shipping label 指快递包裹上的运输标签，含地址、条码、追踪号。搭配：print a shipping label、return shipping label。

examples.en: Please print a shipping label and attach it to the parcel before dropping it off at the courier station.
examples.zh: 寄件前请打印面单并贴在包裹上，然后放到快递驿站。

examples.en: The seller provided a prepaid shipping label for the return, so I didn't pay for shipping.
examples.zh: 卖家提供了预付费退货运单（面单），所以我没有付退货运费。

entries.shortAnswer: 「集运」的英文是 consolidated shipping，指把多个包裹合并成一批统一发运，常用于跨境网购。
entries.definition: consolidated shipping 指将多个包裹合并成一批统一发运的物流方式，可节省运费，常见于跨境网购与代购。

examples.en: The shopping agent offers consolidated shipping, so my orders from different sellers arrived in one box.
examples.zh: 这家代购提供集运服务，所以我从不同卖家买的东西装在一个箱子里寄到了。

examples.en: If you choose consolidated shipping, the warehouse will hold your parcels and send them together to cut costs.
examples.zh: 如果你选择集运，仓库会先保管你的包裹，再合并发出以节省运费。

entries.shortAnswer: Consolidated shipping means 集运, combining several parcels into one shipment to save on costs.
entries.definition: Consolidated shipping is a logistics method that merges multiple parcels into one shipment, often used in cross-border e-commerce.

examples.en: The shopping agent offers consolidated shipping, so my orders from different sellers arrived in one box.
examples.zh: 这家代购提供集运服务，所以我从不同卖家买的东西装在一个箱子里寄到了。

examples.en: If you choose consolidated shipping, the warehouse will hold your parcels and send them together to cut costs.
examples.zh: 如果你选择集运，仓库会先保管你的包裹，再合并发出以节省运费。

entries.shortAnswer: 「外卖骑手」的英文是 food delivery rider，指骑电动车或摩托车送餐的人。注意 rider 强调骑行送单，若泛指平台送餐员也可说 delivery driver。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：work as a food delivery rider（当外卖骑手）、a food delivery rider on a scooter（骑电动车的外卖骑手）。rider 侧重骑行，driver 多指开车，送餐语境两者都可，但 rider 更贴切。

examples.en: He works as a food delivery rider to pay for his college tuition.
examples.zh: 他做外卖骑手来赚大学学费。

examples.en: A food delivery rider on an electric scooter pulled up at the gate and handed me my noodles.
examples.zh: 一个骑电动车的外卖骑手停在门口，把我的面递给了我。

entries.shortAnswer: food delivery rider 的中文意思是「外卖骑手」，即骑车送外卖的人。与 delivery driver 的区别在于 rider 强调骑行送单，后者多指开车配送。
entries.definition: 核心词义为送餐骑手，常见于 work as a food delivery rider、a food delivery rider on a scooter 等搭配。口语中也说 delivery guy，正式书面语用 rider 更准确。

examples.en: He works as a food delivery rider to pay for his college tuition.
examples.zh: 他做外卖骑手来赚大学学费。

examples.en: A food delivery rider on an electric scooter pulled up at the gate and handed me my noodles.
examples.zh: 一个骑电动车的外卖骑手停在门口，把我的面递给了我。

entries.shortAnswer: 大件物流即 bulky item shipping，指家具、家电等超规重货的运输，需预约揽收与特殊搬运。
entries.definition: 大件物流英文为 bulky item shipping，指体积或重量超常规的货物运输，常需预约上门和专线配送。

examples.en: For furniture and appliances, choose bulky item shipping instead of standard parcel delivery.
examples.zh: 家具和家电应选择大件物流，而非普通快递。

examples.en: The store offers bulky item shipping with scheduled home delivery and assembly.
examples.zh: 这家店提供大件物流，可预约送货上门并含安装服务。

entries.shortAnswer: Bulky item shipping is 大件物流—moving oversized, heavy goods like furniture, needing special handling.
entries.definition: Bulky item shipping means 大件物流: transporting oversized or heavy goods such as furniture and appliances, requiring special handling.

examples.en: For furniture and appliances, choose bulky item shipping instead of standard parcel delivery.
examples.zh: 家具和家电应选择大件物流，而非普通快递。

examples.en: The store offers bulky item shipping with scheduled home delivery and assembly.
examples.zh: 这家店提供大件物流，可预约送货上门并含安装服务。

entries.shortAnswer: 「闪送」的英文是 instant courier，指同城即时专人直送服务，区别于普通快递 express delivery。
entries.definition: instant courier 指同城即时专人直送，不经中转分拣。搭配：order an instant courier（叫闪送）。易与普通快递 express delivery 混用。

examples.en: I forgot my passport at home, so I booked an instant courier to bring it to the airport within an hour.
examples.zh: 我把护照忘在家里了，所以叫了闪送，一小时内送到机场。

examples.en: For urgent documents, an instant courier is faster than regular express delivery because it goes straight from sender to recipient.
examples.zh: 对于紧急文件，闪送比普通快递更快，因为它从发件人直接送到收件人。

entries.shortAnswer: instant courier 的中文意思是「闪送」，指同城专人直送、点对点取派的即时配送服务。
entries.definition: instant courier: same-city, point-to-point delivery by a dedicated courier, with no sorting hub. Often contrasted with express delivery.

examples.en: I forgot my passport at home, so I booked an instant courier to bring it to the airport within an hour.
examples.zh: 我把护照忘在家里了，所以叫了闪送，一小时内送到机场。

examples.en: For urgent documents, an instant courier is faster than regular express delivery because it goes straight from sender to recipient.
examples.zh: 对于紧急文件，闪送比普通快递更快，因为它从发件人直接送到收件人。

entries.shortAnswer: 代收点的英文是 parcel collection point，指快递暂存后由收件人自取的站点。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：pick up a parcel at a collection point（在代收点取件）。易错：不要译为 delivery point 或 drop-off point。

examples.en: If you missed the delivery, you can pick up your parcel at the nearest parcel collection point.
examples.zh: 如果你错过了派件，可以去最近的代收点取包裹。

examples.en: The courier left a note saying my parcel collection point is open until 9 p.m.
examples.zh: 快递员留了张字条，说我的代收点晚上九点前都开门。

entries.shortAnswer: parcel collection point 的中文意思是“代收点”，即包裹暂存供收件人自取的站点。
entries.definition: 核心词义：a place where parcels are left for customers to collect。常见搭配：nearest parcel collection point。

examples.en: If you missed the delivery, you can pick up your parcel at the nearest parcel collection point.
examples.zh: 如果你错过了派件，可以去最近的代收点取包裹。

examples.en: The courier left a note saying my parcel collection point is open until 9 p.m.
examples.zh: 快递员留了张字条，说我的代收点晚上九点前都开门。

entries.shortAnswer: 「包邮区」英文常说 free shipping zone，指江浙沪等电商默认包邮的核心地带。注意它说的是地域，不是「满额免邮」。
entries.definition: free shipping zone 专指因物流密度高而整片区域默认包邮，如江浙沪；西方多是满额免邮，属消费门槛而非地域概念，搭配 in the free shipping zone。

examples.en: My hometown is in the free shipping zone, so I rarely pay for delivery when shopping online.
examples.zh: 我老家在包邮区，所以网购时基本不用付运费。

examples.en: Sellers often advertise that their products ship free to the free shipping zone within a day.
examples.zh: 卖家常宣传商品发往包邮区可一日送达且免运费。

entries.shortAnswer: free shipping zone 中文叫「包邮区」，指中国电商因物流密集而整片地区默认包邮。它强调地域红利，不是西方那种满额免邮。
entries.definition: free shipping zone 指物流基建带来整片区域包邮，如江浙沪；常与 live in、ship to 搭配。西方免邮多按消费门槛，不用此词表示。口语也可说 within the free shipping area。

examples.en: My hometown is in the free shipping zone, so I rarely pay for delivery when shopping online.
examples.zh: 我老家在包邮区，所以网购时基本不用付运费。

examples.en: Sellers often advertise that their products ship free to the free shipping zone within a day.
examples.zh: 卖家常宣传商品发往包邮区可一日送达且免运费。

entries.shortAnswer: 「超区」的英文是 out of delivery zone，指收件地址不在快递派送范围内。它强调不派送，不是丢件。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：地址 out of delivery zone、包裹退回或转第三方派件。与 remote area（偏远地区）不同，超区强调需自提或改址。

examples.en: Your parcel is out of delivery zone, so please pick it up at the nearest courier station or update your address.
examples.zh: 您的包裹超区，请到最近的快递驿站自提，或更新收件地址。

examples.en: We're sorry, but this address is out of delivery zone and the package will be returned to the sender.
examples.zh: 很抱歉，该地址超区，包裹将被退回给寄件人。

entries.shortAnswer: 「out of delivery zone」的中文意思是「超区」，即地址超出快递派送范围，需自提或改址。
entries.definition: 快递物流用语，用于客服通知或追踪。搭配：be out of delivery zone、an out-of-delivery-zone address。

examples.en: Your parcel is out of delivery zone, so please pick it up at the nearest courier station or update your address.
examples.zh: 您的包裹超区，请到最近的快递驿站自提，或更新收件地址。

examples.en: We're sorry, but this address is out of delivery zone and the package will be returned to the sender.
examples.zh: 很抱歉，该地址超区，包裹将被退回给寄件人。

entries.shortAnswer: 「补发」的英文是 reship the order，即重新寄出原订单，多因包裹丢失或损坏，由卖家免费重寄。
entries.definition: 补发指卖家重新寄出同一订单商品，常见搭配 request a reship（申请补发）、reship the order for free（免费补发）。注意与换货不同。

examples.en: The tracking shows the parcel was lost, so we will reship the order for free.
examples.zh: 物流显示包裹丢失，所以我们将免费补发该订单。

examples.en: If the item arrives damaged, contact us and we'll reship the order to the same address.
examples.zh: 如果商品到货时损坏，请联系我们，我们会补发到原地址。

entries.shortAnswer: reship the order 中文意思是「补发」，即重新寄出同一订单，通常在原包裹丢失或损坏后由卖家免费办理。
entries.definition: reship the order 指卖家重新发出同一订单商品。搭配：reship the order for free、reship the order to the same address，常见于客服物流邮件。

examples.en: The tracking shows the parcel was lost, so we will reship the order for free.
examples.zh: 物流显示包裹丢失，所以我们将免费补发该订单。

examples.en: If the item arrives damaged, contact us and we'll reship the order to the same address.
examples.zh: 如果商品到货时损坏，请联系我们，我们会补发到原地址。

entries.shortAnswer: 「退货运费险」就是 return shipping insurance，退货时赔付运费的电商小保险。
entries.definition: 指电商退货时补贴运费的保险，英文固定说 return shipping insurance，不要说成 freight。

examples.en: I always add return shipping insurance when I buy clothes online, because returning the wrong size costs more than the insurance itself.
examples.zh: 我在网上买衣服时总会加购退货运费险，因为退错尺码的运费比保费还贵。

examples.en: The seller offered return shipping insurance, so I sent the parcel back through the courier without paying for postage.
examples.zh: 卖家提供了退货运费险，所以我通过快递把包裹退回时没有自己付运费。

entries.shortAnswer: Return shipping insurance, 退货运费险 in Chinese, covers return postage in e-commerce.
entries.definition: A low-cost policy that repays return postage on e-commerce orders; say return shipping insurance, not return freight.

examples.en: I always add return shipping insurance when I buy clothes online, because returning the wrong size costs more than the insurance itself.
examples.zh: 我在网上买衣服时总会加购退货运费险，因为退错尺码的运费比保费还贵。

examples.en: The seller offered return shipping insurance, so I sent the parcel back through the courier without paying for postage.
examples.zh: 卖家提供了退货运费险，所以我通过快递把包裹退回时没有自己付运费。

entries.shortAnswer: 「跑腿」的英文是 errand running service，指替人处理取送、代买等杂事的服务。比 courier service 更广，不只是送包裹，还包括代办事务。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：run errands for sb、use an errand running service。与 delivery service 不同，跑腿还可代买、代排队、代取件；同城急送可称 local errand service。

examples.en: If you are too busy to pick up your parcel, you can use an errand running service to collect it for you.
examples.zh: 如果你太忙没时间取包裹，可以用跑腿服务帮你代取。

examples.en: Many students in China rely on an errand running service to buy groceries and deliver packages on campus.
examples.zh: 中国很多学生依赖跑腿服务在校园里代买日用品和送包裹。

entries.shortAnswer: Errand running service 的中文意思是「跑腿」，指替人完成取送、代买等杂事的服务。它比 courier service 范围更广，不只送包裹，还包括代办事务。
entries.definition: Errand running service 指代人处理日常杂事的服务，常见搭配有 offer/provide an errand running service。偏生活化，物流语境下常与同城急送、代取快递相关。

examples.en: If you are too busy to pick up your parcel, you can use an errand running service to collect it for you.
examples.zh: 如果你太忙没时间取包裹，可以用跑腿服务帮你代取。

examples.en: Many students in China rely on an errand running service to buy groceries and deliver packages on campus.
examples.zh: 中国很多学生依赖跑腿服务在校园里代买日用品和送包裹。

entries.shortAnswer: 「半日达」的英文是 half-day delivery，指包裹在半日内送达的快递时效服务。
entries.definition: 作名词，常见搭配有 offer half-day delivery、half-day delivery service。多用于电商物流语境。

examples.en: This online store offers half-day delivery for orders placed before 11 a.m. in major cities.
examples.zh: 这家网店在主要城市为上午十一点前下的订单提供半日达服务。

examples.en: If you choose half-day delivery at checkout, the courier will deliver your parcel within the same half-day window.
examples.zh: 如果你在结算时选择半日达，快递员会在同一个半日时段内送达包裹。

entries.shortAnswer: half-day delivery 的中文意思是「半日达」，指包裹在半日内送达的快递服务。
entries.definition: A delivery service completing within half a day. Common with half-day delivery option, fee, or service.

examples.en: This online store offers half-day delivery for orders placed before 11 a.m. in major cities.
examples.zh: 这家网店在主要城市为上午十一点前下的订单提供半日达服务。

examples.en: If you choose half-day delivery at checkout, the courier will deliver your parcel within the same half-day window.
examples.zh: 如果你在结算时选择半日达，快递员会在同一个半日时段内送达包裹。

entries.shortAnswer: 「送货上门」的英文是 home delivery，指快递把包裹直接送到收件人住宅，而不用去驿站或快递柜自提，省时又省力。
entries.definition: home delivery 指快递从网点送到收件人指定地址的派送方式，强调“到家”。常搭配 offer home delivery、free home delivery，与 self-pickup 相对。

examples.en: This online store offers free home delivery for orders over a certain amount.
examples.zh: 这家网店订单满一定金额即可享受免费送货上门。

examples.en: I chose home delivery instead of self-pickup because I wasn't going to be near the parcel locker.
examples.zh: 我选择了送货上门而不是驿站自提，因为我不顺路去快递柜。

entries.shortAnswer: Home delivery 的中文意思是「送货上门」，指包裹被直接送到收件人家中，无需去驿站或快递柜取件，方便快捷。
entries.definition: Home delivery 指快递公司把包裹送至家中，对应中文“送货上门”。常搭配 offer home delivery、free home delivery，与自提相对。

examples.en: This online store offers free home delivery for orders over a certain amount.
examples.zh: 这家网店订单满一定金额即可享受免费送货上门。

examples.en: I chose home delivery instead of self-pickup because I wasn't going to be near the parcel locker.
examples.zh: 我选择了送货上门而不是驿站自提，因为我不顺路去快递柜。

entries.shortAnswer: 「无接触配送」的英文是 contactless delivery，指快递员与收件人不面对面交接的派件方式；注意它只描述交接方式，不等于「免运费」free shipping。
entries.definition: 常用于外卖、快递、生鲜场景，强调把包裹放门口、驿站或快递柜，双方不见面；常见搭配有 offer/request contactless delivery、contactless delivery option。

examples.en: During the pandemic, many couriers offered contactless delivery and left parcels at the door.
examples.zh: 疫情期间，许多快递员提供无接触配送，把包裹放在门口。

examples.en: You can select contactless delivery when placing the order, and the parcel will be put in a locker.
examples.zh: 下单时你可以选择无接触配送，包裹会被放进快递柜。

entries.shortAnswer: contactless delivery 的中文意思是「无接触配送」，指快递员把包裹放在门口、快递柜或驿站，不与收件人当面交接；它不等于 free shipping（免运费）。
entries.definition: 正式与日常场合都通用，常见搭配有 offer contactless delivery、choose contactless delivery、contactless delivery option；与 curbside pickup 不同，前者仍由配送方送达指定地点。

examples.en: During the pandemic, many couriers offered contactless delivery and left parcels at the door.
examples.zh: 疫情期间，许多快递员提供无接触配送，把包裹放在门口。

examples.en: You can select contactless delivery when placing the order, and the parcel will be put in a locker.
examples.zh: 下单时你可以选择无接触配送，包裹会被放进快递柜。
